promotionalText: Keep Primary study material, event preparation, flashcards, and instructor gouge together. Start with the free tier and explore Premium study tools.
description:
Primary Gouge brings your Primary study resources into one place. Prepare for events, review emergency procedures and limits, explore reference material, and learn from instructor gouge.

A signed-in account is required. Sign in with Apple or a verified email account, then select your squadron and syllabus.

The free tier includes Home, the NATOPS Question of the Day, EPs / Limits / N/W/C flashcards, instructor gouge, Contacts ground school, FAM2101, and FAM2102.

Premium unlocks the remaining event pipeline, study libraries, videos, quizzes, progress statistics, and advanced study tools. Study progress and quiz history are stored on your device. You can download available videos for offline study and configure a daily study reminder.

Use in-app reporting to flag incorrect gouge or abusive community content. Contributions are moderated.

Premium is an automatically renewing monthly subscription purchased through Apple. The app displays localized pricing and any introductory offer for which your Apple Account is eligible before purchase. Manage or cancel through your Apple Account’s Subscriptions settings; deleting your Primary Gouge account does not cancel the subscription. Restore Purchases is available from the Premium screen.

Primary Gouge is a study utility, not an official training publication. Always verify information against current governing publications, squadron guidance, and instructor direction.

Apple Standard EULA: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
notes:
Primary Gouge requires sign-in and includes a permanent free tier. The dedicated reviewer account must be entered in the Sign-In Information fields and have a server-controlled Premium override verified before submission.

After sign-in: Home contains free emergency-reference flashcards and the Question of the Day. Events → Contacts → Sims includes free FAM2101 and FAM2102. Other Premium content remains visible and shows a purchase gate for free accounts. More → Premium contains purchase, restore, and Apple subscription management. More → Profile contains account deletion. Instructor reviews have reporting controls; authorized moderators have More → Moderation with review/report queues and contributor blocking.

Premium Monthly product: bolt.primarygouge.premium.monthly. US price: $5.99/month with a seven-day introductory free trial for eligible Apple Accounts. Localized price and eligibility come from StoreKit.

Before submission, verify reviewer credentials and override, live support/privacy URLs, content distribution rights, Apple sandbox reconciliation, renewal/refund notifications, and account deletion.
